Berana Shemon is an Aes Sedai of the White Ajah. She has allied herself with the Salidar Aes Sedai and was elected Sitter in the Rebel Hall of the Tower, despite being too young. She has no Warder.

page.overview:
Who is Berana Shemon?

Berana Shemon is an Aes Sedai of the White Ajah. She has allied herself with the Salidar Aes Sedai and was elected Sitter in the Rebel Hall of the Tower, despite being too young. She has no Warder.

She is 5'4 1/2 tall, haughty, with big brown eyes cold as snow and dark brown hair. She looks slim compared to Aledrin and has silver-embroidered white skirts.

Berana is weak in the One Power for an Aes Sedai, with a strength level of . This is too weak to Travel without linking with another channeler.

Berana is seventy years old, she was born in the year and went to the Tower in . After spending ten years as Novice and eight as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year .
